## Context / Problem
The src/rebar/_commands cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The current sweep is pinned to `b10a2309d65b4128c30dd7839a6d9905b8158e63`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope

The semantic DD command lists the exact 108 current block IDs across 18 paths. The unchanged `# raw-git-ok:` directive is protected and excluded from the remediation count. Eleven paths changed since the frozen audit; the current-parent text defines each contract and word count. The focused command uses existing test paths after 5 old tests were removed and 2 moved.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [x] Every preserve item and consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by a row-by-row completion comment and the commands under Verification.
- [x] No executable behavior or test assertion changes; verified by the commands under Verification exiting 0.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
